notes.title: 【Menhera Farm】Store Page Now Live!—Will You Stay with Your DOLLs Until the End…？
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45656279/d34cf547f920eb4a77d95a5ad9e04b9e2b6665d5.jpg"][/img][/p][h1]【Menhera Farm】[/h1][h2]Add the game to your wishlist to be notified the moment it's released![/h2][h1] [dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3761780/_/?curator_clanid=42434109"][/dynamiclink]～ Story ～[/h1][h2]You’ve been chosen to join a top-secret national project—the DOLL Trainer Initiative.[/h2][p]These “DOLLs” may look like ordinary girls, but beneath their delicate exteriors lie powerful combat weapons.[/p][p]Your mission:[/p][p]Train them into the ultimate warriors, send them into the arena, and climb to the top as champions.[/p][p]But—[/p][p]Though they are weapons, they also possess emotions.[/p][p]Mistreatment, excessive pressure, or ignoring their feelings may lead them down the path of destruction.[/p][p]Will you raise a champion who can save the world?[/p][p]Or will you be left with nothing but a tragic breakdown?[/p][h1]～ Character ～[/h1][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45656279/3aa2717260a3cc56b04fee2b4bf75074d114e390.png"][/img][/p][h3]Momo[/h3][p]High luck and super friendly! No obvious weaknesses—perfect for beginner trainers![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45656279/299618a5580a8b0da3c4be1167e7ebf022804dc5.png"][/img][/p][h3]Emy[/h3][p]Exceptional learning ability! Physically and socially weak, but excels through training.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45656279/5bfe8ec9b5eefc346eae3898456edbcda29af457.png"][/img][/p][h3]Sango[/h3][p]A reliable, all-round “big sister” type. Versatile but stress-prone. Best cheered up through frequent dates ♡[/p][h1]～ Game System ～[/h1][p]The battle stage in Mindforge Atelier is the Arena—a tiered, level-based 1v1 competition.[/p][p]Your task is to train your DOLLs, challenge champions of each tier, and ultimately reach the S-Class to unlock the ending.[/p][p][/p][p]◆ A Balanced Mix of Training and Combat[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45656279/cedfd9d15d8570ac46bb101713d89a1119065152.png"][/img][/p][p]Boost the DOLL’s four core attributes through daily “Lessons” and “Dates”:[/p][p]HP (Health): Extends lifespan and improves endurance in combat[/p][p]GTS (Guts): Increases skill activation efficiency and reduces stress[/p][p]POW (Power): Affects attack strength and rhythm difficulty[/p][p]LCK (Luck): Improves training success and critical hit chances[/p][p][/p][p]Each DOLL has a limited lifespan, so managing your training schedule and pacing is key.[/p][p]Use the Reincarnation System to pass down partial stats to the next generation, letting your training legacy continue![/p][p][/p][p]◆ Arena System × Rhythm Combat[/p][p]Combat features a rhythm-based command system:[/p][p]Follow the beat of the music with taps, holds, and other actions—your accuracy directly affects the outcome.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45656279/3b5a12f29aac58509857d414d507dca1d87ece35.gif"][/img][/p][p]Each match offers a limited number of ♥ (Heart) attacks (max 3), determined by HP and GTS[/p][p]Each ♥ attack consumes one heart and is powered by POW; critical hit chances depend on LCK[/p][p]Perfect combos fill the Skill Gauge, which can trigger game-changing abilities![/p][p]Earn money after each battle to buy items, attend advanced courses, or unlock new training options.[/p][p][/p][p]◆ Strategy and Ranking System[/p][p]The Arena consists of several tiers, each guarded by a Champion—defeating them is required to advance.[/p][p]Other opponents are optional, but to 100% complete the game, you'll need to defeat them all.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45656279/305bc98b17e3b754d1848531c7774487432ece34.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Losing a match significantly increases stress, shortens lifespan, and may end the training prematurely.[/p][p]Before battle, remember to check items, skills, and rest status to keep your DOLL in top form![/p][p][/p][p]◆ Key Stats That Affect Endings and Survival[/p][p]Affection: The key to unlocking personal CGs and unique endings[/p][p]Hatred: One wrong word may spike it. At 100, something will happen...[/p][p]Stress: High stress reduces lifespan and may trigger special (not always pleasant) events[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45656279/a7f8a0652fc6df996663c482996d03371cee0283.jpg"][/img][/p][p]After defeating the S-Class champion, you’ll unlock the ending route.[/p][p]But to view a true affection ending, you must first meet these conditions:[/p][p]1. Specific date locations[/p][p]2. High affection[/p][p]3. Zero (or very low) hatred[/p][p]4. Triggered special events[/p][p]These factors determine whether your story ends in bittersweet farewell, painful parting, or a true happy ending.[/p][p]─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── [/p][h2]~ COMING SOON ~[/h2][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3301900/VenusBlood_RAGNAROK_International/?curator_clanid=42434109"][/dynamiclink][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3185540/_/?curator_clanid=42434109"][/dynamiclink][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3689830/_/?curator_clanid=42434109"][/dynamiclink][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3413490/_/?curator_clanid=42434109"][/dynamiclink][/p][p] ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────  [/p][h2]~ info ~[/h2][list][*][p] [url="https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/BokiBokiGame"]BokiBoki Game Steam Publisher Page[/url] [/p][/*][*][p] [url="https://x.com/bokibokigames"]X[/url] [/p][/*][*][p] [url="https://www.facebook.com/bokibokigames"]Facebook[/url] [/p][/*][*][p] [url="https://discord.gg/tv4k6jFHKu"]Discord[/url] [/p][/*][/list][p]Visit the BOKIBOKI official website for more details.
